meta.name: add-mnemon
meta.description: Add persistent graph-based memory via mnemon. Agents recall past context before responding and remember insights after each turn.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体记住每次对话的上下文和洞察
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想让智能体在多次对话中保持记忆
copy.tagline_en: Enable agents to remember context and insights across conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to retain memory across turns

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会在每次回答前自动翻看之前记下的对话记忆,回答后再把本轮的新内容存进记忆库。记忆存放在每个代理组的 .claude/ 目录,容器重启后依然保留。
howto.when: 每次容器启动时,技能会自动注册记忆钩子;之后每当 Claude 要回答时,会自动调取相关记忆,回答结束后自动存入新内容。仅在使用默认 Claude 提供方的代理组上生效。

say.text: 上次我们讨论过数据库索引的问题,结论是什么?
say.note: 触发 Claude 回忆此前对话

say.text: 请记住:这个项目的截止日期是下周五。
say.note: 让 Claude 把这条信息存入长期记忆

say.text: 记住,客户统一用英文沟通,写回复时注意。
say.note: 存入规则,之后回答会遵守

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude automatically reviews previously stored conversation memories before answering, and saves new insights from each turn into memory afterwards. Memory lives in each agent group's .claude/ directory and survives container restarts.
howto.when_en: On every container start, the skill registers memory hooks. Before each reply, Claude recalls relevant past context; after each turn, it stores new insights. Hooks only fire for groups using the default Claude provider.

say_en.text: What was our conclusion about the database indexing issue last time?
say_en.note: Triggers Claude to recall prior conversation.

say_en.text: Please remember: this project's deadline is next Friday.
say_en.note: Stores this fact in long-term memory.

say_en.text: Remember that clients communicate in English; adjust replies accordingly.
say_en.note: Saves a rule for future responses.
